reference_sql:
SELECT a.product_id, a.list_price_eur AS earlier_price, b.list_price_eur AS later_price
FROM price_history a
JOIN price_history b
  ON b.product_id = a.product_id
 AND b.valid_from > a.valid_from
 AND (a.valid_to IS NULL OR b.valid_from <= a.valid_to)
alternatives:
WITH pairs AS (  -- one row per pair of overlapping windows
  SELECT a.product_id, a.list_price_eur AS earlier_price, b.list_price_eur AS later_price
  FROM price_history a
  JOIN price_history b
    ON b.product_id = a.product_id
   AND a.valid_from < b.valid_from
   AND b.valid_from <= COALESCE(a.valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31')
)
SELECT product_id, earlier_price, later_price
FROM pairs

other_way.sql:
WITH pairs AS (  -- one row per pair of overlapping windows
  SELECT a.product_id, a.list_price_eur AS earlier_price, b.list_price_eur AS later_price
  FROM price_history a
  JOIN price_history b
    ON b.product_id = a.product_id
   AND a.valid_from < b.valid_from
   AND b.valid_from <= COALESCE(a.valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31')
)
SELECT product_id, earlier_price, later_price
FROM pairs
other_way.tradeoff: COALESCE with a far future date turns an open window into a dated one, while the OR with IS NULL says plainly that it is open.

solver.query:
WITH ov AS (
  SELECT a.product_id, a.valid_from AS a_from, a.valid_to AS a_to, a.list_price_eur AS a_price,
         b.valid_from AS b_from, b.valid_to AS b_to, b.list_price_eur AS b_price
  FROM price_history a
  JOIN price_history b ON a.product_id = b.product_id AND a.valid_from < b.valid_from
  WHERE b.valid_from <= COALESCE(a.valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31')
)
SELECT product_id, a_price AS earlier_price, b_price AS later_price FROM ov
